facts.business: Jupiter Infomedia Limited operates through its subsidiaries: Jineshvar Securities Private Limited, an RBI-registered NBFC engaged in investment in shares and securities, and Netlink Solutions (India) Limited, a BSE-listed company engaged in web designing, print media, information media (advertisement and exhibition), software development, and investment of surplus funds in equity shares.

segments.name: Web designing, print media, information media, software development and investment (NSIL)
